label: Industrial Abrasive Blast Cabinet
description: A sealed, high-pressure chamber used for bulk matrix removal on large specimens using heavy-duty abrasive media.

components.function: Allows the user to manipulate the specimen and blaster while maintaining a dust-tight seal.
Directs a wide stream of abrasive media (Dolomite or Aluminum Oxide) for rapid clearing.
Protects the main glass from being etched by reflecting abrasive media.

game_mechanics.visibility_degradation: The more the player blasts, the more the 'viewing window' scratches, requiring a shield replacement to restore clarity.
game_mechanics.bulk_clearing: Much faster than the air-scribe but provides less control; using this on 'small fauna' would destroy the specimen.
